tasks.label: Iniciar SocioClub (solicitar contraseña DB)
args: Set-Location 'backend\SocioClub'; $secure = Read-Host 'Contraseña de la base de datos' -AsSecureString; $env:SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD = (New-Object System.Net.NetworkCredential('', $secure)).Password; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run; Remove-Item Env:SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD
